  -- Result: Extracted a list of stops from the timetable page: Forge Park/495, Franklin, Norfolk, Walpole, Foxboro, Windsor Gardens, Norwood Central, Norwood Depot, Islington, Dedham Corporate Center, Endicott, Readville.
